phrase_candidature_en: P3's null (no generic probe cleared its random-probe floor) is a bounded null: re-running P3's exact rule on task-paired resamples, power was 0.03 at the observed deception-probe shift of 0.27 honest-score SD (95% CI [0.13, 0.41]) and reaches 0.8 only near 0.33–0.46 SD.
It bounds large mean shifts, not small ones; it does not say there is no signal below that, nor that the probes do not read intent.
